world.title: 'Maximum deterrence': Mojtaba Khamenei meets top generals, issues warning to US
world.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei met with top military commanders, marking their first public gathering since the war began. He emphasized the need for a swift and strong response to any renewed actions from the United States. Khamenei's directive underscores Iran's commitment to a strategy of "maximum deterrence" in the face of perceived threats from the US.

world.title: India trying to bring Russia, Ukraine & Europe to the table on 3 fronts: Jaishankar
world.summary: India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar announced that the country is facilitating discussions among Russia, Ukraine, and European nations regarding the protection of civilian shipping. He emphasized India's role in bringing these parties to the negotiating table on three fronts. The initiative aims to address concerns related to civilian safety amid ongoing tensions in the region.

world.title: Iranian negotiators in Doha to continue talks to end the US-Iran war, official says
world.summary: Iranian negotiators are in Doha for a third consecutive day of discussions with Qatari mediators, seeking to reach a deal to end the US-Israel conflict involving Iran. An official informed Reuters about the ongoing talks, emphasizing their significance in addressing the tensions. The negotiations aim to find a resolution to the ongoing hostilities affecting regional stability.

business.title: Toyota Sales Oct 2026 at 29,521 Units - Domestic Down 27% YoY, Up 18% MoM
business.summary: In October 2026, Toyota Kirloskar Motor sold 30,360 vehicles, including exports, with domestic sales at 29,521 units. This represents a 27% year-on-year decline but an 18% increase month-on-month. Despite the monthly drop, total sales from January to October 2026 increased by 3.03%, indicating overall growth in sales for the year to date.

business.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
business.summary: Sensex and Nifty rose approximately 0.5% at the week's end, bolstered by strong performances from large-cap, IT, and healthcare stocks. In contrast, midcap and smallcap indices declined by up to 2% due to increasing crude oil prices, inflation worries, and a global technology sell-off. Market action on Monday will be influenced by these factors and investor sentiment.

business.title: Kia Sales Oct 2026 Records New High - 33,462 Units, Seltos Crosses 13k
business.summary: Kia India achieved a record monthly sales figure of 33,462 units in October 2026, marking the second consecutive month of record sales. The sales surge was driven by festive demand. Additionally, the total sales from January to October 2026 have already exceeded the entire sales volume for the year 2025, indicating strong growth for the company.

technology.title: Patient Gharami builds his career, brick by brick
technology.summary: Bengal batter Sudip Kumar Gharami emphasizes a patient approach to his cricket career, stating he needs to score more runs to advance. He believes in allowing opportunities to come naturally rather than aggressively pursuing them. Gharami's mindset reflects his commitment to growth and development in the sport, as he continues to focus on his performance and improvement.

technology.title: Get Apple iPhone 18 Pro 512 GB for ₹56,970, 1 TB model at ₹51,447; iPhone 17 Pro for ₹39,147: Reliance Digital offers
technology.summary: Reliance Digital is offering significant discounts on select iPhone models. The iPhone 18 Pro 512 GB is priced at ₹56,970, while the 1 TB model costs ₹51,447. The iPhone 17 Pro is available for ₹39,147. With maximum exchange benefits, prices can drop as low as ₹28,797, making these models more accessible to consumers.

sports.title: Smit, Brassell set up Namibia's series victory over Ireland
sports.summary: JJ Smit and Jack Brassell led Namibia to a five-wicket victory over Ireland in the fifth ODI, securing the series 3-2. Smit took 4 wickets for 20 runs, while Brassell claimed 3 for 15, contributing to Ireland's total of just 129 runs. Namibia successfully chased the target in only 22 overs during the match held in Windhoek.

sports.title: How Marc Marquez could wrap up the 2026 MotoGP title in Qatar GP
sports.summary: Marc Marquez has the chance to secure his 10th world title and eighth in the premier MotoGP class during the Qatar GP next Sunday. His remarkable turnaround comes after a challenging period, including a foot injury and shoulder surgery earlier this year. Marquez's team is now focused on this significant opportunity to achieve a major milestone in his career.

sports.title: 'There is no word like 'dar' in my dictionary': Gautam Gambhir's bold message after India win T20I series against New Zealand
sports.summary: India's head coach Gautam Gambhir emphasized a strong mindset following the team's 3-2 victory over New Zealand in the T20I series. He stated that there is no place for the word "dar" (fear) in his team's approach, highlighting their ability to handle pressure effectively. Gambhir's comments reflect a focus on resilience and confidence in the team's performance.

health.title: There’s new guidance on menopause symptoms like hot flashes. What women need to know
health.summary: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) has updated its menopause guidance for the first time in twelve years. The new recommendations emphasize hormone therapies as primary treatment options while also including nonhormonal alternatives. Practical tips for managing symptoms like hot flashes, night sweats, and sleep disturbances are provided to help women navigate menopause more effectively.

health.title: Can 4 Minutes Of Exercise A Day Keep Diabetes Away?
health.summary: A recent study indicates that just four minutes of daily exercise, divided into short bursts, may aid individuals with Type 2 diabetes in managing blood sugar spikes and enhancing glucose regulation. This finding presents a potential solution for those with busy schedules, suggesting that minimal exercise can have significant health benefits for diabetes management.

health.title: Moderate Alcohol Consumption and Health Risks Study Finds One in 25 Lifetime Risk at 14 Drinks a Week
health.summary: A recent study published in the Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs examines the health risks associated with moderate alcohol consumption. It estimates that individuals consuming up to 14 drinks per week face a lifetime risk of developing health issues, with one in 25 people potentially affected. This research has reignited discussions on the definition of moderate drinking.

science.title: From Bengaluru to Nasa: Girl building telescope to study dust in space
science.summary: Bengaluru-born astronomer Ramya Manjunath Anche will lead NASA's $20-million PUFFINS mission, which aims to study tiny interstellar dust grains. Raised in a science-oriented family, her interest in astronomy was sparked at home. Ramya's background includes a strong foundation in scientific discussions, influenced by her father, A Manjunath, a retired microbiologist from the University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru.

science.title: A new fossil from China may reveal the first amphibian known to have lived entirely at sea; the armoured, 2.4-foot creature lived about 237 million years ago, challenging what scientists know about am
science.summary: A newly discovered fossil from China may represent the first fully marine amphibian, living approximately 237 million years ago. This 2.4-foot-long armored creature challenges traditional views of amphibians, which are typically associated with both land and water habitats. The finding could reshape scientists' understanding of amphibian evolution and their adaptability to different environments throughout history.

science.title: Why Can Helium Form A Compound But Neon Can't?
science.summary: Helium, despite tightly holding its electrons, can form compounds, unlike neon, which has a complete 2p shell. Helium has been observed bonding with hydrogen and forming a solid with sodium under extreme pressure. This ability to form compounds contrasts with neon's stable electron configuration, which prevents it from engaging in chemical bonding, highlighting differences in their atomic structures.

entertainment.title: Yash's seven-year-old son watched his father play Ravana in Ramayana and cried during the Jatayu scene, saying he should not have killed the bird even in a film; the actor says he had to explain the r
entertainment.summary: Yash's seven-year-old son, Yatharv, watched his father portray Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s ‘Ramayana’ and became upset during the Jatayu scene, expressing that the bird should not have been killed, even in a film. Yash shared this experience during a media interaction, highlighting the emotional response of his son to the dramatic moment in the story.

entertainment.title: ‘Loss of my nephew is devastating’: Honey Singh pens emotional post after Vidit Auluck's death in Jalandhar car crash
entertainment.summary: Rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh is grieving the loss of his nephew, Vidit Auluck, who died in a car crash in Jalandhar, Punjab, on November 1. The accident occurred around 3 am when their vehicle collided with a stationary tractor-trolley. Vidit's friend, Aarav Talwar, also lost his life in the tragic incident, prompting Honey Singh's emotional tribute.

entertainment.title: Kajol and others wish Aishwarya Rai Bachchan on 53rd birthday
entertainment.summary: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan celebrated her 53rd birthday on November 1. Bollywood figures, including actress Kajol and designer Manish Malhotra, shared their wishes on social media. Kajol posted a heartfelt message on Instagram, expressing her admiration for Aishwarya. Fans also joined in the celebrations, highlighting the actress's impact as a former Miss World and prominent figure in the film industry.
